eyebrow.zh: 在已接入的工具分发点检查能力 profile，拒绝越界回调并记录允许与拒绝的原因。
eyebrow.en: Check capability profiles at an integrated tool dispatcher, refuse disallowed callbacks and record allow/deny reasons.

headline.zh:
工具执行之前，
先检查允许范围
headline.en:
Before a tool runs,
check its allowed scope.

sub.zh: 在已接入的工具分发点检查能力 profile，拒绝越界回调并记录允许与拒绝的原因。
sub.en: Check capability profiles at an integrated tool dispatcher, refuse disallowed callbacks and record allow/deny reasons.

caption.zh: 调用检查 · 显式接入

body.zh: 拒绝时不会调用底层 callback。
body.en: Denied requests never reach the wrapped callback.

body.zh: 每个 profile 绑定技能并列出能力范围。
body.en: Each profile binds a skill and lists capabilities.

body.zh: allow/deny 与触发规则进入 trap log。
body.en: allow/deny decisions and rules enter the trap log.

title.zh: 把策略放到工具分发点
title.en: Put policy at the tool dispatcher

body.zh: 当宿主允许技能调用工具时，声明中的权限范围需要被实际执行路径检查。Capsule 提供宿主 adapter 和 Interposer，让调用方在进入真实工具回调前执行工具、路径和网络规则。安装 Python 包本身不会自动接管所有 Agent。
body.en: A skill’s declared scope needs enforcement in the actual tool path. Capsule supplies a host adapter and Interposer so callers can check tool, path and network rules before entering the underlying callback. Installing the Python package alone does not take over every agent.

body.zh: 真实 guard_tool_use 在 network-deny 与 readonly 两个 profile 下检查三个请求，仅允许 Read 回调运行。它验证回调级拒绝边界，没有连接真实 Agent 或验证系统调用隔离。
body.en: The real guard_tool_use checks three requests under network-deny and readonly profiles, allowing only the Read callback. It validates callback-level refusal, not a live agent integration or syscall isolation.

alt.zh: 真实 guard_tool_use 在 network-deny 与 readonly 两个 profile 下检查三个请求，仅允许 Read 回调运行。它验证回调级拒绝边界，没有连接真实 Agent 或验证系统调用隔离。
alt.en: The real guard_tool_use checks three requests under network-deny and readonly profiles, allowing only the Read callback. It validates callback-level refusal, not a live agent integration or syscall isolation.

body.zh: host adapter 将工具事件转换成 CallRequest；policy.decide 按工具允许集、路径 deny、读写范围和网络 host 依次判定；Interposer 在拒绝时先记录并抛 CapabilityViolation，允许时才调用被包装函数。TrapLog 支持内存或 JSONL，CLI 可查看报告。
body.en: The adapter converts tool events into CallRequest. policy.decide checks allowed tools, path denies, read/write scope and network hosts. Interposer records and raises CapabilityViolation on denial, invoking the wrapped function only on allowance. TrapLog supports memory or JSONL, with CLI reporting.

alt.zh: host adapter 将工具事件转换成 CallRequest；policy.decide 按工具允许集、路径 deny、读写范围和网络 host 依次判定；Interposer 在拒绝时先记录并抛 CapabilityViolation，允许时才调用被包装函数。TrapLog 支持内存或 JSONL，CLI 可查看报告。
alt.en: The adapter converts tool events into CallRequest. policy.decide checks allowed tools, path denies, read/write scope and network hosts. Interposer records and raises CapabilityViolation on denial, invoking the wrapped function only on allowance. TrapLog supports memory or JSONL, with CLI reporting.

body.zh: Capsule 的拦截能力来自调用者主动包住 dispatcher，而非透明接管机器。保留原始 trap log 有助于复查，但日志不是所有未插桩动作的完整审计。
body.en: Capsule’s enforcement comes from explicitly wrapping a dispatcher rather than transparently controlling the machine. Trap logs aid review but are not a complete audit of uninstrumented actions.

alt.en: Capsule’s enforcement comes from explicitly wrapping a dispatcher rather than transparently controlling the machine. Trap logs aid review but are not a complete audit of uninstrumented actions.

body.zh: 仅安装 CLI 不会自动保护现有宿主；需要显式包装执行函数。
body.en: Installing the CLI does not automatically protect a host; its execution function must be wrapped.

note.zh: 真实 guard_tool_use 在 network-deny 与 readonly 两个 profile 下检查三个请求，仅允许 Read 回调运行。它验证回调级拒绝边界，没有连接真实 Agent 或验证系统调用隔离。
note.en: The real guard_tool_use checks three requests under network-deny and readonly profiles, allowing only the Read callback. It validates callback-level refusal, not a live agent integration or syscall isolation.

body.zh: 一个允许回调、两个拒绝，记录具体规则。
body.en: One callback is allowed and two denied, with rule names retained.

body.zh: 在更窄工具允许集下重复检查相同请求。
body.en: Check the same requests under the narrower tool allowlist.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+。下面只调用模拟 host callback，不执行任何文件、shell 或网络动作。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12+. The demo invokes simulated host callbacks and performs no file, shell or network actions.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/capsule.git
cd capsule
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .

python examples/presentation_demo.py network-deny
python examples/presentation_demo.py readonly

limitations.zh: 工具级策略不是内核 seccomp、容器或系统级沙箱。
limitations.en: Tool policy is not kernel seccomp, a container or a system sandbox.

limitations.zh: 未接入的调用不受控制，shell 意图解析也不是完整 shell 语义。
limitations.en: Unintegrated calls are uncontrolled, and shell-intent parsing is not complete shell semantics.

limitations.zh: 本次只验证模拟 callback 的执行边界。
limitations.en: This run validates only the simulated callback boundary.
